holoprint.config.hotbar_tools.tip: In the free camera the hotbar shows the editor tools (1 Move, 2 Select, 3 Copy, 4 Delete, 5 Layers, 6 Materials, 7 Load, 8 Build, 9 Menu) and the number keys use them without leaving the camera. Tab still opens the full menu.
holoprint.message.easy_wrong: Holoprint: the hologram asks for another block there (%s) that cannot be placed yet, so the block in hand is not placed.
holoprint.message.easy_protected: Holoprint: that block (door, trapdoor, gate, repeater, comparator...) is already as the schematic asks, so it is not changed by accident.
holoprint.message.easy_far: Holoprint: that block of the hologram is %s blocks away; your reach is %s. Move closer.
holoprint.message.easy_support: Holoprint: there is no block next to that spot to place it against. Put a first block (or scaffolding) beside it.
holoprint.message.easy_state: Holoprint: that block cannot be placed in the right state from here. Try from another side.
holoprint.load.empty: There are no schematics in the %s folder.
holoprint.load.pick: Pick a file from the list.
holoprint.load.unsupported: File type not supported: use .litematic, .schem or .schematic.
holoprint.hud.no_schematic: No schematic is loaded. Press Tab and the Ld button to load one.
holoprint.hud.trimmed: Very big hologram: drawing the closest blocks (%s of %s in view).
holoprint.config.conflict: This key is also used by: %s
holoprint.config.press_key: Press the new key (Esc to cancel).
holoprint.load.info.name: Name: %s
holoprint.load.info.author: Author: %s
holoprint.message.restore_missing: Placement not restored, the file is missing: %s (it is kept in case the file comes back)
holoprint.hud.copy.moving: You carry the selected area. Click: move the real blocks here (with /clone; if you turn or mirror it, it is rebuilt)
holoprint.message.move_same: Holoprint: the area is already there.
holoprint.message.move_overlap: Holoprint: the new place overlaps the old one too much; move it in smaller steps.
holoprint.message.move_no_access: Holoprint: moving the real blocks needs cheats (operator permissions).
holoprint.hud.move.build: %s: build the whole hologram in the world (needs cheats)
holoprint.message.build_none: Holoprint: there is no placement to build.
holoprint.message.build_no_access: Holoprint: building everything at once needs cheats (operator permissions).
holoprint.message.build_busy: Holoprint: a build is still running (or another could not be started).
holoprint.message.build_confirm: Holoprint: you are about to build %s blocks of "%s" in the world, no materials spent. Press %s again to confirm.
holoprint.materials.wrong_setting: %s blocks have another setting (delay, mode, note)
holoprint.config.show_legend.tip: Shows the keys of the current mode in a corner while the editor is open.
holoprint.config.confirm_delete.tip: Deleting the selected area needs the delete key pressed twice in a row. It prevents accidents.
holoprint.config.show_holograms.tip: Master switch. When off, every hologram is hidden without removing it, and assisted placement and the error marks stop working too.
holoprint.config.show_entities.tip: Draws, frozen, the entities a schematic holds (item frames, armor stands, animals...). They are only created in the world by the build-everything key (B).
holoprint.config.easy_place.tip: Right click on a hologram places the block of the gold-outlined cell with its exact facing and state. It also opens or closes doors like the schematic, adjusts repeaters and comparators, and writes signs. Has its own key in the controls.
holoprint.config.fill_held.tip: While you hold the use button it keeps placing, one after another, the hologram's blocks within your reach (bottom to top, nearest first), only of the same type as the first one. The speed is set under Limits.
holoprint.config.no_support.tip: Lets a block go in a gap with nothing beside it (the server accepts it when it is within reach). When off, blocks are only placed against one that already exists.
holoprint.config.hide_built.tip: Stops drawing the blocks that are already in the world, so you only see what is missing. It updates at once when a block is placed or broken.
holoprint.config.show_differences.tip: Red outline: another block where a different one goes. Orange: the right block, turned or opened the wrong way. Yellow: the right block with another setting (repeater delay, comparator mode, note).
holoprint.config.show_extra.tip: Blue outline where the hologram asks for nothing and there is a block. Off by default because it would mark all the terrain around the build.
holoprint.config.opacity.tip: From 10 % to 100 %. Low values let you see the world through the hologram; at 100 % it hides what is behind it.
holoprint.config.hologram_color.tip: Tint applied to the whole hologram, in hexadecimal (#RRGGBB). White keeps the original colours.
holoprint.config.selection_color.tip: Colour of the box that marks an area.
holoprint.config.flow_color.tip: Colour of the arrows that show which way water and lava flow.
holoprint.config.biome_colors.tip: Grass, leaves, ferns and sugar cane take the tint of the biome the hologram stands in, as in the game.
holoprint.config.show_block_entities.tip: Draws the blocks that have their own model: chests, signs with their text, beds, banners, heads, shulker boxes... Without their items.
holoprint.config.limit.0.tip: How many schematics can be loaded at once.
holoprint.config.limit.1.tip: How many blocks from the camera the hologram is drawn.
holoprint.config.limit.2.tip: Largest size, in blocks, of an area that can be copied or saved.
holoprint.config.limit.3.tip: Cap on the blocks drawn each frame. Lower it if the game is slow with huge schematics.
holoprint.config.limit.4.tip: Blocks per second of the auto-fill, from 1 to 20 (20 is one block per tick). High values may upset servers with anti-cheat.
holoprint.config.fluid_animations.tip: The water and lava of the hologram use the game's own textures, with their movement and current. When off, they are drawn as plain coloured blocks. Their height by level always shows.
holoprint.message.layer_all_only: Holoprint: to change layer, first switch to a single layer (%s)
holoprint.config.block_outlines.tip: Draws a line around every block of the hologram, as Litematica does, so the pieces are easy to tell apart. Its colour is set below.
holoprint.config.outline_color.tip: Colour of the lines around each block of the hologram.
holoprint.config.flow_arrows.tip: Draws arrows on flowing water and lava, showing which way they run. Their colour is set above.
holoprint.tool.build: Build the whole placement in the world (needs cheats)
holoprint.message.move_turned_containers: Holoprint: this server does not let the game read what is inside chests, so turning or mirroring this area would empty them. Move it without turning.
holoprint.message.build_confirm_commands: Holoprint: you are about to build %s blocks of "%s" by sending commands to the server, no materials spent (it can take a while). Press %s again to confirm.
holoprint.message.build_commands: Holoprint: sending %s commands to build (about %s seconds). Press the build key again to stop.
holoprint.message.build_stopped: Holoprint: build stopped; %s commands were not sent.
holoprint.config.container_contents.tip: Pointing at a chest, barrel or other container of a hologram lists the items the schematic holds inside it.
key.holoprint.materials: Material list of the active placement
holoprint.hud.materials: %s: material list of the active placement
holoprint.message.easy_outside: Holoprint: that block would go outside the hologram, so it is not placed. Put it where the hologram asks for it (or switch assisted placement off).
holoprint.message.easy_no_open: Holoprint: that block opens or switches, so it is not used while you are placing. Click it once, without holding, to use it.
